dslRule:
<!id: java-project-is-open-check>
<!description: Corrects the API usage for checking if an Eclipse IJavaProject is open, changing from IJavaProject.isOpen() to IJavaProject.getProject().isOpen().
This addresses Bug 501069 where IOpenable.isOpen() incorrectly returned false for an open JavaProject.
>
<!severity: WARNING>

$var.isOpen() :: instanceof($var, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IJavaProject")
=>
$var.getProject().isOpen()
;;
